notes.title: Small Fixes Update
notes.notes:
Quick patch today!

✨ Intro polished up – smoother start to the adventure.
⚔️ All attacks & defenses hit harder – card battles are faster, punchier, and more fun.

That’s it for now—just keeping things lively! Thanks for playing 💛

Kevin
— dev

notes.title: Preview Update
notes.notes: Preview of upcoming Update. This build allows you to expereince some of the new features this game will be taking on. The first portion is completed. The rest is still in development. The target completion is expected to be in about 2 weeks.

notes.title: Major update in the works
notes.notes:
Hi friends! We received some feedback and some errors in our game. Now, after a little break and time to work on a couple of other projects have passed, it's time to come back. There are 3 issues we are working hard to fix/update and correct.

1) Battle system - getting a revised setup throughout the game. This includes different encounters and an integrated lesson system so teach you how to use your cards to their fullest abilities.

2) We're also adding some new skins for your character. As well as the ability to change your character through various ways. Such as using a mirror to change your hair and clothes. And new clothes avilable at the local shop.

3) The biggest change will be to the core story. We've now have a professional writer to help us create a deeper story experience.  We are really excited share the new story with you soon.

These changes will take some time but our goal is about 30 days. So hopefully shortly after Thanksgiving holiday this month, we will have the update ready for December. Thank you for your support at launch and we will do our best to make the game even better!

notes.title: Amaze Adventure Pre-Release Demo
notes.notes:
Welcome and thank you for checking out our first Adventure game release! This project started with the pen and paper style rpg games we played with our friends in school. Originally, we built one map for fun and it just went from there. More and more. Ever expanding world to explore and mini-games to play. Fun items to collect and more coming soon.

Be sure to add Amaze Adventure to your Steam Wishlist - for March 18, 2020 release!

We would love to hear your questions, comments, and general feedback. Maybe your idea will make it in to the final build. Or maybe you'll help us fix some problems with fun or gameplay. That's what this short demo is made for.

Note: everything is unlocked but limited to 30 minutes of game play. Also all of the battle cards are unlocked!
